mounts.name: Crimson Tidestallion
mounts.notes: This mount is sold infrequently by Mrrl , a murloc vendor at your Nazjatar faction hub, as part of a complex bartering system. Here's how to purchase one: Complete the intro quests for Nazjatar to the point where you unlock world quests. Find the wounded murloc - Mrrl in the north of Dragon's Teeth Basin and accept its rescue quest ( A Safer Place / A Safer Place ) and bring it to your faction hub - Newhome for Horde, or Mezzamere for Alliance. Upon completing the quest, four more vendor murlocs will appear around your hub: Grrmrlg, Hurlgrl, Mrrglrlr, and Flrgrrl. Mrrl offers you one more quest to buy four items from the other murlocs. After you complete the final quest, Mrrl also becomes a vendor. The item(s) it offers may be purchased using items bought from the other murlocs, which in turns require other items sold by the same murlocs, i.e. a kind of bartering game. The items Mrrl sells change daily so you'll need to be patient and check back every day. In the meantime there are other things you need to do: Obtain an Azsh'iri Stormsurger Cape . These are created (randomly) from Benthic Cloak tokens which can be purchased from the benthic gear "Vaultkeeper" in your hub for 5 Prismatic Manapearls. Depending on how lucky you are it may take a few tries. You can earn more Prismatic Manapearls by completing various daily / world quests. You won't see the Crimson Tidestallion for sale on Mrrl unless you're wearing this cape. Two of the three epic items required as currency for the Crimson Tidestallion (see 'Cost', above) can be purchased from the other murloc vendors around your hub, but only when you're wearing your Azsh'iri Stormsurger Cape . Otherwise the items are hidden. These items have a 1-day duration so don't purchase them until the day the mount is on sale! The third currency item you need is a Hungry Herald's Tentacle Taco . This is sold by Murloco, a murloc who appears infrequently in Murloco's Hideaway in the north-west of Nazjatar (his cave is roughly due west of the "A" in "Azshari Terrace" and due south of the second "E" of Queen in "Gate of the Queen" on the zone map). You may need to camp his cave for some time before he appears. You may also need to kill some naga guards to free him. Fortunately his item doesn't have a finite duration, so it can be purchased days in advance. If you don't want to work out the bartering game for yourself, here's what you need to buy: Round 1: purchase 288 Unidentified Mass from Flrgrrl; 128 Sweet Sea Vegetable from Hurlgrl; 714 Slimy Naga Eyeball from Mrrglrlr. This will cost you 1130 gold. Round 2: using the items you just bought, purchase 238 Curious Murloc Horn from Grrmrlg; 32 Just Regular Butter from Flrgrrl; 48 Dirty Murloc Socks from Hurlgrl Take the 48 Dirty Murloc Socks to a water source and wash them (click on them till they're all Clean Murloc Socks). Round 3: using the items you just bought, purchase 16 Sea Giant Foot Dust from Grrmrlg; 28 Ghost Food from Flrgrrl; 14 Healthy Murloc Lunch from Hurlgrl; 16 Smelly Pile of Gloop from Mrrglrlr Round 4: using the items you just bought, purchase 2 Pulsating Blood Stone from Mrrglrlr; 4 Cultist Pinky Finger from Hurlgrl Round 5: using the items you just bought plus the Hungry Herald's Tentacle Taco, purchase the Crimson Tidestallion from Mrrl!

mounts.name: Ivory Cloud Serpent
mounts.notes: To collect this pale-rose cloud serpent you'll first have to obtain a Zan-Tien Lasso . This is a rare drop item from hostile Mogu which appear during Mogu Assaults in the west of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. You must then use the lasso on the Ivory Cloud Serpent , a rare NPC which spawns during Mogu Assaults, to obtain the mount. The Ivory Cloud Serpent spawns every ~1.5 - 2.5 hours at coordinates ~ 27,55, at roughly 2-3 times the height of the trees, and flies rapidly in clockwise circuits around the zone. You can lasso the serpent while on a flying mount, though not while moving, so you'll have to be fast. Multiple players can also lasso and win this mount at the same time, but you'll have to be quick as it despawns mere seconds after the first player successfully lassoes it. This mount's texture has an interesting history. It initially appeared in the Mists of Pandaria game files, but was soon replaced by the icy-blue skin used by the Malevolent Gladiator's Cloud Serpent and was then deleted entirely. Fortunately someone at Blizzard located and restored it.

mounts.notes: This handsome horned steed is a reward for achieving 100 Exalted reputations. Factions / individuals with reputation levels that do not have a literal 'Exalted' rank are unlikely to count (such as the Brawler's Guild, which has numerical ranks, and various NPCs that have friendship levels). Originally this achievement was purely single-character, but it's now account-wide, though you have to log on the other characters for their reputations to register. However (i) the same Exalted reputation on two characters will only count as one, and (ii) paired reputations from opposite factions only count as one. For example, Orgrimmar and Stormwind will only count for one reputation, as will Kurenai and The Mag'har. This part can be confusing!

mounts.name: Vicious Black Bonesteed
mounts.notes: This dark purple variant of the Vicious Skeletal Warhorse was the Horde rated PvP match reward for Battle for Azeroth Season 2. You can still obtain this old mount but it's now more complicated: you must first obtain the Vicious mount for the current season , then compete enough times to obtain a second mount within the same season. The full procedure is: Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

mounts.name: Vicious War Wolf
mounts.notes: To purchase this armoured wolf you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows: You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season , until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts , including this one. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

mounts.notes: The Seedbloom required to purchase this mount can earned by completing the quest Blooming Dreamseeds , which can be done once per week per character. There's also a small chance of getting this mount as a reward from Emerald Bounty events in the Dream when a Gigantic (purple) seed has been planted. Emerald Bounties are repeatable activities where you plant a Dreamseed (Small, Plump, or Gigantic) at one of a number of designated locations around the Dream, then harvest a lootable Bounty several minutes later. During the event, you can contribute Emerald Dewdrops to the growing seed to increase your rewards. Emerald Dewdrops can be earned from various activities in the Dream, including activities that pop up around the growing seed during the 3-minute event period.

mounts.name: Delugen
mounts.notes: This ottuk is one of six transparent, green "Emerald" mounts that are purchasable from Elianna in the Emerald Dream. To obtain this mount, you must: Reach renown rank 5 with the Dream Wardens. Speak to Elianna in the Central Encampment and complete the quest Emerald Reawakening . This unlocks an account-wide ability to obtain Dream Infusions. You can acquire Dream Infusions by accumulating Dream Energy through various activities around the Dream, until you fill a progress bar. Speak to Elianna to check your Dream Energy progress bar. Once your Dream Energy progress bar has reached 100%, you can obtain a Dream Infusion from Elianna, which you can use to purchase the green mounts and pets. However! There's one extra restriction: you must already own a mount that has the same model as the green one you're purchasing, just in a different colour. See the "Other Mounts Using the Same Model" section on this page for a list of mounts that should work (they're currently untested).

You must have completed the quest chain for Lizi . You must have collected 3 Stolen Breath of Ohn'ahra , which is a chance drop from Balakar Khan, the last boss in The Nokhud Offensive dungeon, on any difficulty level. After you've complete these prerequisites, speak to Godoloto , north-west of Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains and receive the quest.

Once you've obtained the shell, journey to the Empowered Snail (actually a slug!) around 71.0, 25.0, in the east of the Scalecracker Keep region, in the north of the zone. Bring along as many health/protection buffs as you can. Enter the magma and interact with the snail to cast 'Embiggening Snail' on it. It takes 20 seconds to complete the cast, and during this time you'll be taking a lot of damage from the magma. Having a healer on hand will help, as will any class abilities that mitigate damage or heal over time. You'll need to use these just before interacting with the snail as you can't do anything once you start without interrupting the channel. After the channel is complete you'll receive this mount.

mounts.name: Mimiron's Jumpjets
mounts.notes: This mount was introduced during the Secrets of Azeroth event in 2023, but it can still be created even after that event has ended. To assemble Mimiron's Jumpjets, you need to collect three booster items that are located around Azeroth. Two of the three require multiple people to obtain. The First Booster Part drops from a specially summoned rare NPC in the middle of Jaguero Isle in the Cape of Stranglethorn (59.4, 79.0). Look for a place with three large bowls on the ground. The rare is named Enigma Ward and it can only be spawned by 3 players with a Torch of Pyrreth toy. Other players can loot the component. The Second Booster Part can be looted after a special event involving the Enigmamental in northern Felwood, at 50.0, 26.3, and requires 4 players. One player should click on the translucent yellow "Engine" item beneath the Enigmamental, activating it. The Enigmamental will then "absorb" the player (non-lethally). After it has absorbed a further 3 players (4 total), it will drop the Booster object from which anyone can loot the Second Booster Part. The Third Booster Part requires no helpers. Simply go to the steps on the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands, at 54.8, 52.2, where you'll see a "Mimiron's Booster Part" that you can loot. However, you can't loot it while in combat, and the periodically spawning hostile NPCs will interrupt you. The easiest way to loot it is simply to ride a flying mount and hover close enough to loot the item without attracting any aggro. After you've gathered your three components, you can fuse them to create the mount at the Empowered Arcane Forge in Valdrakken (36.4, 62.2). After the Secrets of Azeroth is over, the forge permanently empowered, but while it's running it must be empowered via special 15-minute events every 4 hours (look for a blue forge icon on your Valdrakken map and mouse over it to see the time until the next event). These events involve carrying Power Source items back to the forge and require a community effort. See this Wowhead guide for more information.

mounts.name: Mossy Mammoth
mounts.notes: This green-haired mammoth can be obtained in the Forbidden Reach by progressively combining a number of items that can be obtained from Zskera Vaults. You unlock these vaults during the zone intro quest chain, and obtain vault keys mostly from defeating rare NPCs in the zone. The item sequence is: Obtain a Scrap of Black Dragonscales and a Strange Petrified Orb from chests in the Vaults, and combine them to create a Particularly Ordinary Egg . Obtain a Drop of Blue Dragon Magic from the Vaults and combine it with the Particularly Ordinary Egg to form a Magically Altered Egg . Obtain Everburning Ruby Coals from the Vaults and combine it with the Magically Altered Egg to form an Egg of Unknown Contents . Obtain a Speck of Bronze Dust from the Vaults and combine it with the Egg of Unknown Contents to form a Sleeping Ancient Mammoth . Obtain an Emerald Dragon Brooch from the Vaults and combine it with the Sleeping Ancient Mammoth to create your Mossy Mammoth . Note that the Speck of Bronze Dust and Emerald Dragon Brooch seem to come from much later vaults, which will require clearing one vault a week for several weeks.

mounts.name: Otto
mounts.notes: This otter mount is the reward for the quest, The Way to an Otto's Heart , but getting to that point is... kind of nuts. First, obtain Aquatic Shades which have a 50% chance of appearing in an Immaculate Sac of Swog Treasures , purchased from The Great Swog in the Ohn'ahran Plains at 82.3, 73.2. You'll need a Gold Coin of the Isles to purchase a sac, and these are super-rare items that can be obtained through fishing, or can be traded up from lesser-quality coins - see the Wowhead link for more information. Once you've obtained your Aquatic Shades, head to the Bubble Bath dive bar in the waters just north of the Obsidian Citadel, around 19.6 36.5 in The Waking Shores (the area above the bar is called the Hissing Grotto). By the bar, locate and stand on a small, 3x3 disco-style dance floor, wear your glasses and dance for 5 minutes. You'll know you have the right spot if you receive the debuff, Dance, Dance 'Til You're Dead which tracks your dancing time. You'll know your dancing is complete when you are teleported. In your new location you'll see an Empty Fish Barrel , which you should pick up. You need to fill the fish barrel with 100 Frigid Floe Fish , 25 Calamitous Carp , and 1 Kingfin, the Wise Whiskerfish . These fish can be obtained by fishing around the Dragon Isles - see the Wowhead links for location info. Once you've filled your barrel, head to the Hissing Grotto, around 20.3 39.7 and place your barrel on the ground. Otto should then appear with the quest, The Way to an Otto's Heart , granting you the mount.

Each Seething Orb gives you a stack of Insidious Insight and you need three stacks to be able to see and open the chest. Emerald Bounties are repeatable activities where you plant a Dreamseed (Small, Plump, or Gigantic) at one of a number of designated locations around the Dream, then harvest a lootable Bounty several minutes later. During the event, you can contribute Emerald Dewdrops to the growing seed to increase your rewards. mounts.notes: This dreamstag is one of six transparent, green "Emerald" mounts that are purchasable from Elianna in the Emerald Dream. To obtain this mount, you must: Reach renown rank 5 with the Dream Wardens. Speak to Elianna in the Central Encampment and complete the quest Emerald Reawakening . This unlocks an account-wide ability to obtain Dream Infusions. You can acquire Dream Infusions by accumulating Dream Energy through various activities around the Dream, until you fill a progress bar. Speak to Elianna to check your Dream Energy progress bar. Once your Dream Energy progress bar has reached 100%, you can obtain a Dream Infusion from Elianna, which you can use to purchase the green mounts and pets. However! There's one extra restriction: you must already own a mount that has the same model as the green one you're purchasing, just in a different colour. See the "Other Mounts Using the Same Model" section on this page for a list of mounts that should work (they're currently untested).

mounts.notes: This gorgeous drake mount allows you to take the form of the eminent blue dragon, Tarecgosa, tragically now deceased. To obtain this mount you must first already own the legendary staff, Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest , which can be obtained through a quest chain that begins in the Firelands, and is only available to classes who can wield staves (shaman, mages, priests, warlocks, druids, evokers). Once you own the staff, you must then complete the epic new Blue Dragonflight storyline, added to the Dragon Isles in Patch 10.1. The quest chain begins with Kalecgos asking to meet you at the Veiled Ossuary. If you own the Dragonwrath staff, Kalecgos will offer you an extra series of quests at the end of the main story, which culminates in you receiving this mount. mounts.name: Smoldering Ember Wyrm
mounts.notes: This mount drops from Nightbane in the Return to Karazhan dungeon. Drop chance: Blizzard confirmed that the chance of this mount appearing is 20% multiplied by the number of players in your group that are eligible for loot (i.e. not loot-locked for that week). Party members who already have the mount still add to the drop chance, though they cannot receive it again. So, if you have 5 members in your party who are eligible for loot there's a 100% chance that the mount will drop for someone who doesn't already have it, and if only one member of a party of 5 doesn't have this mount then they're guaranteed it. But if you only have three players in your group and one is loot-locked, the chance drops to (3-1) x 20 = 40% that one eligible player will receive it. This loot rule hasn't changed in Battle for Azeroth.

mounts.name: Vicious War Bear
mounts.notes: To purchase this armoured bear you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows: You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season , until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts , including this one. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).
mounts.requirements: This mount is available to all eligible characters on your account. Level 10 Apprentice Riding Horde only

mounts.name: Ancestral War Bear
mounts.notes: This mount can be looted from the Honored Warrior's Cache , found in a cavern under a tree - entrance at 47.0, 82.3 in Solemn Valley below the mountain west of Temple of Akil'zon in Zul'Aman (Midnight). First, you should visit and interact with the cache, but you won't be able to open it yet. Now you need to kill and loot four Echoes of the Past around the zone. You summon them by clicking on Honored Warrior's Urns at specific locations: Nalorakk's Chosen - found at 32.7, 83.5 - on a rocky outcropping between waterfalls just east of Nalorakk's Prowl. Drops a Bear Tooth. Akil'zon's Chosen - found at 51.6, 84.9 - on a ridge half way down the mountainside south of the Temple of Akil'zon. Drops an Eagle Feather. Jan'alai's Chosen - found at 54.8, 22.4 - just south of the Temple of Jan'alai. Drops a Dragonhawk Feather. Halazzi's Chosen - found at 34.5, 33.5 - above a lynx den, east of Temple of Halazzi. Drops a Lynx Claw. These are level 90 NPCs and will be more difficult at lower levels. With the four looted items in hand, return to the Honored Warrior's Cache and you should be able to loot the mount.

mounts.name: Echo of Aln'sharan
mounts.notes: After completing To Sow the Seed in the main Harandar quest chain, a side-quest chain will open up, beginning with Tales of the Sky and ending with The Legend of Aln'sharan . After completing this chain you can now loot Mysterious Skyshards from NPCs in Harandar (including Harandar delves). These have a low drop rate and you have to collect 500 of them! When you're done return to Kuri and use the extra action button to throw them into the water. Before the next step, (unless you're a druid) prepare some kind of slow fall, or have something suitable ready in your bags as the next interaction requires you to dismount in mid-air. It's also useful to switch to steady flying before the next step. When you're ready, go find Aln'sharan , the translucent blue cloud serpent who flies about the edge of the zone, but be careful: the hostile winds around the periphery can cause you a lot of damage, so you need to be quick! Fly right up to him and dismount and quickly interact with him to receive his mount item.

mounts.name: Spawn of Vyranoth
mounts.notes: This mount is awarded by completing Master of the Turbulent Timeways V, which is part of the fifth Turbulent Timeways event, added in Patch 12.0.7. Turbulent Timeways is a special Timewalking event in which five different sets of Timewalking dungeons are available over five or more consecutive weeks. Assuming it works like previous events, to obtain this mount: Run four Timewalking dungeons on one character for each of four weeks (was previously five weeks) of the event. You can switch characters between weeks of the event. Each Timewalking dungeon should award your character one stack of the experience buff Knowledge of Timeways. As this buff only lasts two hours you need to complete the next dungeon in less than two hours after completing the previous one. Gaining four stacks of Knowledge of Timeways on one character will grant you the Mastery of Timeways buff. This is all you need to do for that week. Repeat this each week, for four weeks of the event. You can complete the weekly requirement on different characters in different weeks (as the achievement is account-wide), but you must complete each weekly buff on a single character for that week. After you gain Mastery of Timeways for each of the four weeks you'll complete the achievement and receive this mount! As with rewards from previous Turbulent Timeways events, it's likely this mount will become purchasable from any Timewalking vendor some time after the event concludes.

To do this, you'll find a Lost Bear Cub at 55.8, 49.7, behind a small tree on a terrace next to the north-eastern stairs. Interact with it and feed it one Practically Pork to obtain the pet item. Learn and summon Chubs and head to 55.8, 39.3, which is in the north-east of the instance. It's marked by scattered raw meat or animal remains just to the east of the northern ritual buildings and terrace, and just west of an enormous tree. Approaching the meat will summon an Angry Amani Warbear . Subdue it in combat then interact with it and feed it 5 Practically Pork to receive the mount item. Ritual Sites are small, scaling instances for 1-5 players, with optional challenge tiers, added in Patch 12.0.5. See Wowhead's Ritual Sites Guide for more information.

mounts.notes: The Bloody Coins required to purchase this mount may be obtained by engaging in a special type of PvP: You are awarded a coin if you get the killing blow on a PvP opponent while you are transformed into an Ordon Fire-Watcher . To transform into an Ordon Fire-Watcher you need to purchase the item, Fire-Watcher's Oath , sold by Speaker Gulan on the Timeless Isle for 100 Timeless Coins . Timeless Coins are earned easily by killing NPCs/opening chests/performing various quests on the Timeless Isle. The Fire-Watcher's Oath buff should work anywhere where PvP is allowed (including battlegrounds). The Censer of Eternal Agony (toy) can be used instead, but it has many downsides: its usage is restricted to the Timeless Isle, it has much longer cooldowns, and it debuffs the victim so that they won't grant more than one coin within a 10-minute period. On the other hand it allows you to kill members of your own faction who are similarly flagged, which the Fire-Watcher's Oath doesn't.

mounts.name: Vicious Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.notes: To purchase this armoured skeletal steed you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows: You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season , until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts , including this one. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

mounts.name: Ascended Skymane
mounts.notes: The Ascended Skymane has a small chance of dropping from the Cache of the Ascended , which is the loot chest reward from defeating the Ascended Council in Bastion. Summoning the Council can be difficult as it requires ringing all five vespers in Bastion within a 5-minute period, which is not possible without help and/or alts at each vesper's location (players must be level 60). Farming this mount can therefore be difficult, and it may be hard to find enough interested players in the zone at any given time, so it could well be easiest to keep checking group finder for "Ascended" groups. The vespers become inactive 5 minutes after the first has been rung and they take 1-2 hours to reset, which is why group coordination is important. Once all five vespers have been rung, the Ascended Council will assemble at Aspirant's Awakening, in the south of Bastion (~ 53, 88). They can be a challenging fight. Vesper locations are: Vesper of Courage: The Necrotic Wake, south of Temple of Courage (~ 33, 60) Vesper of Humility: at the back of the Temple of Humility (~ 72, 39) Vesper of Purity: at the back of Purity's Pinnacle (~ 64, 70) Vesper of Wisdom: on the floating platform in The Eonian Archives (~ 39, 20) Vesper of Loyalty: Exaltation Rise, in the north-east of Citadel of Loyalty (~ 32, 18) See also the achievement Rallying Cry of the Ascended .

When you reach rank 3 you'll unlock the ability to repair Broken Mirrors in Revendreth, using a Handcrafted Mirror Repair Kit sold by Simone in Sinfall. When you repair a mirror you can use it to access a hidden room with a Forgotten Chest you can loot. The chest can award various goodies, including Silessa. Only three mirrors are available for repair at any one time, and you can repair each once per day. Typically, the mirror locations change with the weekly reset, but sometimes sooner. It also appears that the mirror locations are grouped, so if you find one you can determine where the other two are by looking them up. Refer to this comprehensive Wowhead article for a full list.

This creature can only be activated / made attackable by a member of the Venthyr Covenant who has their Anima Conductor channeling to Wanecrypt Hill. If you meet these requirements then you can loot a Ballista Bolt , which can be found at several locations in the ruined fortress on the hill just to the west of Harika's area (you can see these on your minimap and one can be found around 42,81). You should then proceed east and down the hill and speak to Wingsmash at 46,78. This giant will offer a dialogue in which hand him the Ballista Bolt. mounts.name: Hulking Deathroc
mounts.notes: This purple deathroc has a small chance of dropping from the Violet Mistake , a specially-summoned NPC that appears at the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities (59,74) in the House of Plagues, Maldraxxus. To summon this rare you should be familiar with the mechanics of the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities and achieve a purple (even balance of blue and red ingredients) mixture. Essentially, you need to kill red and blue slime creatures in the area and pick up the materials they leave after they die (Viscous Oil and Mephitic Goo, respectively) and add them in even amounts to the pool until it reaches an ingredient count of 30. It is also allowable to add some yellow ingredients (Miscible Ooze) to the pool, providing that the amount of yellow remains lower than the other two colours. This means that you must add between 11 and 15 each of red and blue ingredients, and 0 to 8 yellow (and the amount of yellow must be an even number). The Violet Mistake will spawn as soon as the addition count reaches 30, providing the pool is purple. Note that this pool is a communal effort and it's possible another player will show up and unwittingly mess up your mixture balance.

mounts.name: Shimmermist Runner
mounts.notes: To obtain the Shimmermist Runner, you have to negotiate the correct path through Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald to reach it. While there are other ways of getting there, it will be invisible unless you take the correct way. A clue to taking the correct path can be found on a blue pennant attached to a tree in the Oaken Assembly at 33, 53 - this is at the north end of a large clearing where Karon Ruz can be found and is roughly west-south-west of the Root-Home flight point. It suggests you should always choose the path with From there: Head south to the start of the maze, which is a large archway flanked by two blue lamps (approximately 31, 55). Follow the wide road south until you see an archway to the left with two blue lamps above it (30, 56). Choose that passage. Proceed a short distance, then take the first passage to the right, which has an archway with one blue lamp hanging (30, 58). Then take an immediate left through the archway with a blue lamp on the ground (29, 59) - don't be deceived by the arch to the right with a hanging pink lamp. Then take an immediate right through the archway with one hanging blue lamp. You should be in a clearing with four other exits. Ignore the ones with pink lamps and take the exit with the blue lamp on the ground, which is roughly straight ahead and is the third exit from the left (28, 58). You should be in another clearing with four other exits. Take the second archway from the left, which is flanked by two blue lamps (27, 58). You should now be in the final clearing with Shizgher and the Shimmermist Runner , who should remain visible. Defeat Shizgher then click on a grateful Shimmerist Runner to receive your mount!

mounts.name: Silvertip Dredwing
mounts.notes: This mount can be obtained in different ways depending on which of the four Shadowlands Covenants you're a member of. In each case it requires the use of your covenant's special feature (below), which must be activated and upgraded with Reservoir Anima: Venthyr Covenant - The Ember Court . Can be purchased from Temel for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, The Ember Court. This doesn't require the Court to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks. Night Fae Covenant - Queen's Conservatory . Chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Prideful" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5. Kyrian Covenant - Path of Ascension . Can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, Curse of Thirst . This requires the feature to be upgraded to rank 3. Necrolord Covenant - Abomination Factory . Can be purchased from Atticus for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, Stitchmasters. This doesn't require the feature to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.

mounts.name: Sinrunner Blanchy
mounts.notes: It appears that in death Old Blanchy did not go to a better place. In Revendreth you can earn her trust, and her reins, through a six-day quest chain. To begin, locate Dead Blanchy in the Endmire in Revendreth. Note that she isn't up all the time: she respawns every 1-2 hours and is only up for 5 minutes at a time. Day 1: bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats from Oat Packs around Saldean's and Molsen's farms in Westfall. Day 2: groom her with a Grooming Brush which you obtain by speaking to Snickersnee in Darkhaven, Revendreth. Day 3: bring her 4 Sturdy Horseshoes which can be found randomly by the roads between Endmire and Darkhaven. Day 4: bring her a Bucket of Clean Water . To obtain this, first collect an Empty Water Bucket which can be found near Snickersnee in Darkhaven, Revendreth. Then proceed to a water source in either Bastion or Ardenweald and fill the bucket. Day 5: bring her a Comfortable Saddle Blanket which may be purchased from Ta'tru at the Night Market in southern Revendreth. The barter items required for this purchase may change weekly. Day 6 - the final day: feed her 3 Dredhollow Apples which may be purchased from Mims , the Innkeeper at the Hole in the Wall in western Revendreth. Thanks to Unholypriest's quest description on Wowhead.

mounts.name: Sundancer
mounts.notes: Note: a player who follows the instructions below should be guaranteed to receive the Sundancer mount. It has been reported that other players who have obtained the same buffs and participate in the battle are also guaranteed to receive the mount, but we haven't confirmed that. To obtain Sundancer you first need to obtain a Skystrider Glider (if you use other gliding methods you won't be eligible for the mount!) . The blueprints for crafting these are earned by members of the Kyrian Covenant who have upgraded their Path of Ascension feature to rank 3 and defeated Kalisthene on Wisdom (3rd level) difficulty. Other players can buy them from the Auction House. You'll also need some friends to help defeat Sundancer, unless you're very well geared. If your friends want to be eligible to receive the mount they'll also need a Skystrider Glider. Proceed to the far south-eastern corner of Bastion (~ 60, 94). If Sundancer is currently available you'll see it slowly path north and south through the sky off the east side of the cliffs. If it's not up you may need to wait up to an hour or so for it to respawn. When you're ready, click on the Ancient Memorial, which is located close to the southermost point. It will grant you the buff Sunrider's Blessing . Helper players who wish to be eligible for the mount should also click on the memorial. You (or another player, but just one player) should then proceed north to the higher cliffs, where they'll be a little higher than Sundancer when it flies by. Wait for Sundancer to be pathing north, then a bit before it reaches you leap out and activate the Skystrider Glider. Quickly glide to the steed and click on it to mount it. At this point, a Soothe button will appear in the middle of your screen and you should start spamming it to calm Sundancer. In between soothes, you can also activate any damage mitigation or heal over time spells you have, as you'll be receiving some damage (though not extreme) as you ride. After a short while Sundancer will calm and head to land, on the southernmost section of terrain, around 60, 94. When you're ready to fight you can speak to Sundancer to challenge it to combat, but note that you'll have less than 5 minutes before your invisible Skystrider Glider buff wears off so you'll need to proceed quickly. Beforehand, helper players should activate their gliders (and ensure they've clicked on Ancient Memorial) to make them eligible for the mount. Combat with Sundancer can be hard unless you're well geared, but not too difficult with help. After defeating Sundancer in challenge combat you should receive the mount!

mounts.name: Swift Gloomhoof
mounts.notes: The Night Mare that drops this mount isn't normally visible, instead you need to use a Dream Catcher and be level 60 in order to see it: First, head to Tirna Scithe, which is the peninsula on the south-west edge of the zone, connected by a narrow land bridge. Head around the north of the zone, to roughly the north-west corner (18, 62). If Oranomonas is the world boss this week they'll be in a different clearing just to thr south of this one. Here you should see a tree hanging off the edge of the world, with roots hanging down. This is the most difficult part: you need to get from the edge of the world over to the narrower winding root. It's apparently possible to jump this on a mount, but you may fail and fall. Hunters can disengage over, Venthyr can use Door of Shadows. Or you can simply use a Goblin Glider Kit. Jump to the adjacent broader tree root, and follow it up to the base of the tree. The cross a tree root bridge back to the mainland. Carefully circle to the left around the base of the enormous tree, until you come to a cart. Click on the Cracked Soulweb at the front of the cart, on the ground. You'll now have a Broken Soulweb . For the next stage, you must have (i) 10 pieces of Lightless Silk, and (ii) completed two quest chains: Trouble at the Gormling Corral and Tricky Spriggans . Neither chain is directly tied to this mount, but unfortunately you can't speak to Elder Gwenna at Glitterfall Basin until they're done. Ensure 10 pieces of Lightless Silk are in your inventory, then head to Glitterfall Basin and speak to Elder Gwenna . If she's present she'll be north-west of the flight point, on the other side of the camp, by Aldas, the General Goods vendor. Select her dialogue to receive a Repaired Soulweb . To enchant your soulweb you need to speak to Ysera in the Heart of the Forest. If you're in the Night Fae Covenant you can simply enter and speak to her directly. If not then you can speak to an Elite Queensguard at the entrance and they'll summon her out to you. Speak to Ysera and you'll receive your Dream Catcher . Head to Dreamshrine Basin, which spans an arc north, east and south of the Hibernal Hollow flight point. Activate the Dreamcatcher. This is a permanent item and you can use it as often as you want, so you don't have to worry that you might waste it. It'll give you a 5-minute buff and put you into a special phase where you can see the Night Mare . If it's currently up it'll path around the area, otherwise you may have to wait half an hour or more for it to spawn. You must defeat the Night Mare to receive the mount. If you're only just at level and not well geared then his can be a difficult fight to solo, but you can receive help from other players who have the Dreamcatcher. Be sure to interrupt its Cosmic Shower ability, and run out of range when it casts Total Eclipse. Good luck!

mounts.name: Vicious War Croaker
mounts.notes: This formidable battle toad is the Horde rated PvP match reward for Shadowlands Season 3. To obtain this mount: Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

mounts.name: Vicious War Spider
mounts.notes: This menacing spider with Forsaken-themed armour is the Horde rated PvP match reward for Shadowlands Season 1. To obtain this mount: Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

mounts.name: Wildseed Cradle
mounts.notes: This unique mount is contained within the Cache of the Moon , which is a treasure located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald. However, this treasure isn't visible until you help the nearby faerie, Twinklestar , find her lost tools. All five items can be found in the Garden of the Night, which is located south-west of the Heart of the Forest or east of the Root-Home flight point. The items you need to collect are: Gardener's Basket - in the north of the garden, by two rocks at the edge of a pool, around 40, 53 Gardener's Flute - in the south of the garden, between a large seed pod and a smaller one, around 38, 58 Gardener's Hammer - in a broken cart, around 40, 54 Gardener's Wand - under a different cart, in the south of the garden, around 38, 58 (not far from the flute) Diary of the Night - on a table on a tree platform in the middle of the garden, around 39, 57. This is the second tree connected by bridges. Once you've collected all five items, right-click on one of them to assemble them into Twinklestar's Gardening Toolkit . Return them to a grateful Twinklestar, who will then cast Moonsight on you. This will allow you to finally see and open the Cache of the Moon behind her.

mounts.notes: In order to buy this mount your faction must be in control of Halaa, a PvP sub-zone of Nagrand in Outland. Otherwise the vendor is absent. Two different currencies are required for the purchase, Halaa Battle Tokens and Halaa Research Tokens. In Warlords of Draenor a large cache of these tokens (more than required for one mount) is given as the reward of a very rare garrison follower mission, Mysteries of Lok-rath . Otherwise you can earn your tokens by the traditional method: Halaa Battle Tokens are awarded for killing opposing faction players at Halaa (which can be painfully slow as the zone is no longer popular), and Halaa Research Tokens are obtained by farming Oshu'gun Crystal Powder (150 for 15 tokens) from the denizens of Nagrand and handing it in to an NPC when your faction controls Halaa. mounts.name: Prismatic Snapdragon
mounts.notes: You can earn this mount through a multi-day quest chain in which you gain the trust of a Starving Snapdragon Runt - found near Zexel Fingersnap at the main quest hub of the Siren Isle. Interact with it to pick up the first quest, A Lifeline . Each day after that you'll be offered a new quest. If you miss a day you can just pick up where you left off, but you can still only complete one quest a day. You can change your mount's colour by feeding it special treats! These are sold by Zexel Fingersnap, but only after you first unlock them by finding them around the Isle. There are eight and you can only obtain them after unlocking the mount: Teal : You receive this one when you first receive your mount. Crimson : Has a low chance of dropping from various 'Bilge Rats'-associated NPCs on weeks when Pirate invasions are active. Inky : Awarded by Gazix Fusegrease , who wanders around the base camp. Talk to him and follow a dialogue by selecting 'I am the Trashmaster!'. For this option to be available you may need either the 'Trashmaster' title or to have obtained Trashmaster's Mantle from Operation: Mechagon some time in the past. But first just give him a try and see if it works! Kaja'Cola-Braised : Obtained from Blinky Greasefingers at the base camp. Ignore his vendor window, instead follow his dialogue options until you receive the treat. Muddy : Has a low chance of dropping from various Vrykul NPCs outside the Forgotten Vault in the north-west of the Isle. Can also drop from other Vrykul NPCs that appear around the Isle on weeks when Vrykul invasions are active. Royal : Has a low chance of dropping from various Naga NPCs on weeks when Naga invasions are active. Sandy : Can be looted from Seafarer's Caches which are found in the sea surrounding the Isle. Storminfused : Has a low chance of dropping from various crabs in the Storm phase of the Isle.

mounts.name: Thrayir, Eyes of the Siren
mounts.notes: This stormy, night-blue crow has existed in the database since early in Patch 5.4, but was only finally added 6 expansions later - in Patch 11.0.7! It can be earned by finding 5 unique Runekeys around the Siren Isle and returning them to the Forgotten Vault, where Thrayir's body lies (inert). Most of the Runekeys can only be obtained while you're in the Special Assignment / Storm phase of the zone, which you can access by first completing the zone's weekly quest, Serpent's Wrath and then talking to Suzie Boltwrench in the main quest hub. The Runekeys can be obtained around the Siren Isle in the following ways: Cyclonic Runekey : can be fished on the coast just south of Zek'ul the Shipbreaker in the Special Assignment / Storm phase (around 32.0, 78.0). It may take quite a few casts. Thunderous Runekey : can be assembled from 5 Thunderous Fragments. These can be obtained (randomly) from treasures and chests around the isle (probably only the Storm phase now). Torrential Runekey : can be assembled from 7 Torrential Fragments. These have a low chance of dropping from any NPC in the Special Assignment / Storm phase. Turbulent Runekey : can be assembled from 3 unique Turbulent Fragments. which are all found in the Special Assignment / Storm phase. These can be obtained: (i) a dirt pile in the garden of an old inn, around 38.2, 51.8, by a ghost; (ii) a small crystal by a ghost inside the Rotting Hole cave in the south-east, around 67.1, 78.4; a small crystal in the hands of a ghost in the Spirit-Scarred Cave, around 52.4, 38.6. Whirling Runekey : drops from Ksvir the Forgotten inside the Forgotten Vault in the Special Assignment / Storm phase (Deadfin Mire - around 33.2, 73.6). Once you've obtained all the Runekeys, head to the Forgotten Vault (entrance around 38.2, 51.8) and interact with Thrayir's body to revive it.

mounts.notes: This flying purple panther can be crafted by players with the jewelcrafting skill. The recipe, Design: Void-Crystal Panther drops only for jewelcrafters, but is guaranteed loot from Big Keech in the Revisited Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar (added in Patch 11.1.5). For him to appear, you have to have at least one mask active; he'll then appear in a hut on the eastern side of the Valley of Honor (which is the easternmost area of the Vision) around 72.4, 34.8. The recipe requires several components that can also be obtained within Revisited Visions. These components can be obtained by players without the jewelcrafting profession and they can then have a Void-Crystal Panther crafted by work order. You must have at least one mask active before you can obtain any of these items : 1 Void-Bound Orb of Mystery is a guaranteed unique drop (you won't see it if you already have one) from Big Keech in the Valley of Honor (Orgrimmar Vision, around 72.4, 34.8) with at least one mask active. You must obtain this item first, before you can see/loot any of the other components. 20 Shadow Infused Onyx can be obtained from your end reward chests with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before they will appear. 4 Black Blood Infused Bars can be obtained from a lootable object (one per run) at the altar in the Valley of Wisdom (Orgrimmar Vision, around 45.2, 52.7) with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before it will appear. 1 Unusual Gems can be obtained from Valeera's end chest, after completing the Old Town area (Stormwind Vision) with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before it will appear. See Wowhead's Revisited Horrific Visions Guide for more information.

mounts.name: Xy Trustee's Gearglider
mounts.notes: Earning this gearglider requires you to be at least Renown 8 with the Manaforge Vandals, which is earned by running the Manaforge Omega raid. To earn it you have to use three different 'Cartel Deal' items, crafted by Scribes (can be available on the Auction House), and locate thee associated 'dead drop' items inside the raid. Each Cartel faction unlocks a different dead drop item (see below). Note that earlier reports said you could only use one 'Deal' (and gain one dead drop) per week without using a cheat script, so it should require three weeks to obtain, but I found I was able to learn all three on the same day, gather the drops from the raid and earn the mount without using any cheat scripts. So maybe that has changed. The cartel deals and associated dead drop locations are: Deal: Cartel Ba - the Cartel Ba Dead Drop can be found after Plexus Sentinel (first boss). Follow the path to the right, and the drop (which looks like a small, grey cylinder) can be found by the right-hand phase warp teleporter that takes you to the centre ring of the raid. Deal: Cartel Zo - the Cartel Zo Dead Drop can be found before Forgeweaver Araz and is the trickiest to obtain. It's located on a pipe around the wall inside Mana-Vent Aphis. You have to jump off the end of the walkway and onto the pipe without dying in the process. Deal: Cartel Om - the Cartel Om Dead Drop can be found after Fractillus. Look behind the building after the boss, and you'll find the drop on a rock. After locating all three drops, speak to Zo'turu just outside the raid and he'll offer you the quest Someone Like Me which awards the mount. See the mount's Wowhead page for more information.
mounts.requirements: This mount is available to all eligible characters on your account. Level 10 Apprentice Riding (ground) Expert Riding (flying)

mounts.name: Crimson Water Strider
mounts.notes: This vivid red version of the Azure Water Strider mount may be obtained in Warlords of Draenor. It is available from Nat Pagle, in your garrison, but he'll only sell it to you if you're one of his Best Friends. The entire process is rather long and complicated! To access Nat Pagle you must build a Fishing Shack in your Garrison and advance it to level 3. To advance your friendship with Nat, you can perform quests for him, from both Warlords of Draenor and Mists of Pandaria. See this Wowhead page for more information. To obtain 100 of Nat's Lucky Coins you have to fish up "lunkers", which are rare variants on regular Draenor zone fish, and turn them in to Nat. The coins are also found as uncommon loot from Cavedweller murlocs in your Garrison's fishing pond in Draenor. The murlocs can be summoned with Lunarfall Carp (Alliance) or Frostdeep Minnows (Horde), which can occasionally be caught from the same pond once you advance your Fishing Shack to level 3. This latter method is probably slower, but there's also a rare chance the murlocs will drop a Sea Turtle or Riding Turtle mount. Before the addition of Mount Equipment this mount was one of only two that were adept at water-walking. This innate ability was removed from water striders in Patch 8.2.

mounts.name: Vicious War Kodo
mounts.notes: To purchase this armoured kodo you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows: You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season , until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts , including this one. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

mounts.name: Vicious War Raptor
mounts.notes: To purchase this armoured raptor you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows: You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds. Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season , until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one). For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle , which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts , including this one. It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter). The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win), 80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or 240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

It will also increase your speed in water by 60%, equivalent to a slow land mount. Its speed is not affected by effects that increase or decrease mount speed. It can be obtained as a very rare catch from fishing pools in Northrend, Pandaria and Cataclysm-level zones, including debris pools around the shores of Darkmoon Island. It can also appear as rare loot from Cavedweller murlocs in your Garrison's fishing pond in Draenor. The murlocs can be summoned with Lunarfall Carp (Alliance) or Frostdeep Minnows (Horde), which can occasionally be caught from the same pond once you advance your Fishing Shack to level 3.
